title: Resolution and Lean 4 Formal Verification of Conjecture 7.7 on the Second-Order Variance of Multinomial Discrete Total Variation
description: Lean 4.35.0 / Mathlib v4.35.0 formalization resolving Conjecture 7.7 (a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243, gamma_2 = -1/(32*pi) - 8*sqrt(3)/(243*pi)) and the quantitative O(L^-2) remainder of Lemma 7.3 from Nikola Banić and Neven Elezović (arXiv:2610.17046v1), with 10 isolated Palomar Comparator targets, 191 author-written theorems and lemmas (896 audited theorem constants + 65 audited definitions), 0 @[nolint] suppressions, 22 NonVacuity theorems replayed via leanchecker, six comparator checker runs + live negative sorry-tamper rejection in CI, and independent exact/80-digit Python oracles.

AI tools (Antigravity / Google DeepMind) assisted with Lean proof engineering and manuscript drafting under human direction and audit.
